WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances AS a
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
)
SELECT bats,
       appearance_count,
       1.0 * appearance_count / SUM(appearance_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       1.0 * appearance_count / AVG(appearance_count) OVER () AS divided_by_average
FROM hand_counts;
